means.example-sentence: The baby has now started to take a good look at anything presented to him before taking it.
means.sentence-jp: その赤ちゃんは今では、自分に差し出されたものは何でも、それを手に取る前にじっくり見るようになってきた。

cloze.maskedText: The baby has now started to ____ anything presented to him before taking it.
cloze.answerBase: have a look (at ~) / take a look (at ~)

notes: look の前には good, close などいろいろな形容詞を入れることができる。
